name: singlet_qc_low_quality_cell_detection
title: Low-quality and damaged cell detection
description: Flags low-quality or damaged cells from per-cell library size, detected genes, top-20 share and mitochondrial fraction, and writes a keep flag per cell with the metrics and thresholds behind it. Needs integer UMI counts in layers/counts after cell calling; set batch_key when libraries are merged so thresholds are per batch. The default mad is the best-practices MAD rule and needs no training; fixed applies hand-set bounds, miqc fits a per-sample mixture, dropkick fits a classifier on heuristic labels. Do not use it on empty droplets, for nuclear-fraction damage calls in nuclei, or without reading the per-type retention it reports.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Decision rule: mad (robust MAD rules, default), fixed (hand-set bounds), miqc (per-sample mixture, gives lowq_prob), dropkick (classifier on heuristic labels, gives lowq_prob).

batch_key.description: obs column naming batches or samples. MAD thresholds and miqc fits are computed per batch; null treats the dataset as one batch.

cell_type_key.description: obs column with cell-type labels; used only to report the retention of each type after filtering.

nmads_counts.description: MADs from the batch median on log1p total counts and log1p detected genes, both sides; null disables both rules.

nmads_top_genes.description: MADs from the batch median on the percentage of counts in the top 20 genes, both sides; null disables the rule.

nmads_mito.description: MADs above the batch median of the logit mitochondrial fraction; null leaves only mito_cutoff.

mito_cutoff.description: Mitochondrial fraction a cell must also exceed to be flagged (logical AND with nmads_mito); 0 disables.

min_flags.description: Number of the four rules (counts, genes, top-20 share, mitochondrial) that must flag a cell for removal; 2 mimics pipeComp lenient.

scale_mad.description: Multiply each MAD by 1.4826 (scuttle convention) before applying the nmads multiples.

share_mads.description: Use one MAD pooled over batches while keeping per-batch medians.

reference_batches.description: Estimate medians and MADs from these batches only; other batches borrow the pooled estimate. Null estimates every batch from its own cells.

fixed.description: Options for method fixed. A null bound is disabled.

min_genes.description: Keep a cell only if it has more detected genes than this.

max_genes.description: Keep a cell only if it has fewer detected genes than this.

min_counts.description: Keep a cell only if its total UMIs exceed this.

max_counts.description: Keep a cell only if its total UMIs are below this.

mito_cutoff.description: Keep a cell only if its mitochondrial fraction is below this; the default is a PBMC convention.

posterior_cutoff.description: Cells with posterior probability of the compromised component above this are removed before the boundary rules.

model_type.description: Regression of mitochondrial percentage on detected genes in each component; one_dimensional models mitochondrial percentage alone.

keep_all_below_boundary.description: Keep cells whose mitochondrial percentage lies below the fitted intact line.

enforce_left_cutoff.description: Also remove cells with no more genes and no lower mitochondrial percentage than the least-mitochondrial removed cell.

min_genes.description: Barcodes with fewer detected genes are excluded from training and receive score 0 and label false.

alpha.description: Elastic-net mixing parameter: 1 is the lasso, 0 the ridge.

n_hvgs.description: Number of highly variable genes used as classifier features.

seed.description: Random seed for miqc EM starting values and dropkick cross-validation folds; other methods are deterministic.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/keep_cell. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs. Keys: method, cells_in, cells_removed, fraction_removed, removed_by_rule (mad, fixed), batches, min_type_retention (null without cell_type_key), thresholds_location, samples_fit and samples_failed (miqc), removed_below_min_genes (dropkick). Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
